extracted.intended_audience: ERC Consolidator Grant applicants, potential applicants, and host institutions
extracted.subtask_description: Official listing of the ERC Consolidator Grant 2025 peer review panel chairs and members, with brief procedural notes for applicants (transparency, confidentiality, and contact points).

rubrics_metrics.name: Panel list and composition
rubrics_metrics.description: The list includes the panel chairs and the panel members in the ERC Consolidator Grant peer review process, identified and invited by the ERC Scientific Council. There are in total 28 panels, divided between 3 domains: 11 panels in Physical Sciences and Engineering (PE), 9 panels in Life Sciences (LS) and 8 panels in Social Sciences & Humanities (SH).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains the names of panel chairs and members for each named panel (PE1–PE11, LS1–LS9, SH1–SH8). Release date is given (25/02/2026) and the full list of peer reviewers (panel members and remote referees) will be published by the European Commission after conclusion of the current peer review process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency / publication of full reviewer list
rubrics_metrics.description: The full list of ERC peer reviewers (panel members and remote referees) will be published by the European Commission after the conclusion of the current peer review process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This document provides partial transparency by publishing panel membership now; a more complete list (including remote referees) is released later by the European Commission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition on contacting peer reviewers
rubrics_metrics.description: Under no circumstances should Peer Reviewers be contacted by applicants, potential applicants, or potential host institutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an explicit rule directed to applicants and host institutions to prevent direct communication with panel members; it is stated as 'for reasons of transparency' and applies throughout the evaluation period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confidentiality obligation of peer reviewers
rubrics_metrics.description: ERC Peer Reviewers are bound to confidentiality during the evaluation and afterwards. Hence, they are not allowed to communicate about the evaluation and/or specific proposal(s) with the principal investigators or potential team members or persons linked to them even after the completion of the evaluation process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This clarifies that confidentiality extends beyond the active evaluation period and prohibits post-evaluation communication about evaluations or specific proposals with applicants or their associates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Official contact channels for queries
rubrics_metrics.description: Questions can be addressed to the ERC Helpdesk or ERC National Contact Points.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants and prospective applicants should use these official channels rather than contacting reviewers directly if they have questions about the process.
